mentions.name: Textual TUI board games app
mentions.description: A TUI app built with Textual for playing board games like Tic Tac Toe and Connect Four, featuring a modified rule that requires forming a square instead of a line.
mentions.source_excerpt: Next, I'm working on a TUI app (using Textual) for board games like Tic Tac Toe and Connect Four. These will also have a modified rule that requires forming a square instead of a line.
